items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD move; arrow keys fire/aim/set facing, and movement+fire combine; tears auto-fire in facing direction. E places/uses bomb (bomb count dropped). Space activates pedestal/item. Q uses/drops held card; Q showed no visible effect and may throw/drop the card. Waiting delays. Fine presses: 0.1s≈40px, 0.2s≈80px, 0.5s≈200px. Door/hatch/gate transitions usually need centered overlap plus 2-3 presses; partial overlap often fails. Player sprite alternates wildly and can render invisible; confirm identity by moving. TV-head and gray-face sprites also appear as enemies.

HUD/PICKUPS (observed): hearts (hollow after damage; blue/soul heart from blue pill), coins, keys, bombs, item/card slots, minimap. Pickups on touch, but coins need exact overlap. Blue pill gave a blue heart, not a key. Red pill suspected heal + blue heart (older, uncertain). Poop can hide/release items (TECH X banner appeared around broken poop); some poop is inert. Chests: contact may open them but can damage once; loot varies (coins or heart+pill); some chests disappear or act mimic-like. A center/spiky brazier-room chest damaged on contact and dropped a heart. Dark-room red-barred chests did not visibly open to sustained TECH X; red marks looked decorative—may be mimics/inert (uncertain). Bombs: bomb-bug explosion dropped a bomb; purchased bomb detonated with smoke but ring rocks stayed intact. Rock rings resisted TECH X and one bomb attempt; ring-chest access unresolved. Bomb-bugs explode on contact and can chain TNT barrels; avoid.

TECH X (observed): radial ring tear with red X impact; large blast circle radius ~140-150px, center usually ~170-200px ahead, but placement/range seemed inconsistent (sometimes short; near walls/obstacles blast can appear at feet). Rocks block the line; point-blank is a blind/unsafe spot. Damages fat, gray faces, shelled, flies, grouped spiders. Does NOT crack rock rings or TNT barrels; left-wall statue showed no damage feedback; embedded eye-faces in boss-room rocks survived direct blasts (likely invulnerable spawners, uncertain). y-offset >~70px misses. Firing near walls/rocks can detonate on/behind you.

ENEMIES: winged flies; knife-topped; fat pink/white enemies are tanky, enrage (red aura), chase, contact drains hearts fast; shelled white-faced enemies emerge from rock piles and leave damaging green clouds; gray wall/embedded faces shoot orbs/tears, seem endless, no coin; small black spiders in dark stone room are fast, cluster, close-range deadly; bomb-bugs are slow, explode on contact, may be burst-immune; green spiky clouds, orbs, and brazier flames damage. Enemies emerge from cracked pods/rock piles. All-hollow hearts were observed while still controllable, then the run ended after all hollow—meaning uncertain (near-death vs extra-life).

NAVIGATION (observed): Tutorial room ↔ bottom hatch → brazier room; top hatch → rock room; right-wall dark riveted door → dark stone room. Brazier room: four corner braziers (fire damages), central rock ring/chest area, poison poop, bottom-center golden gate → dark two-poop chamber (top gold door returns; its chest was/gone mimic-like), top alcove → tutorial; left corridor bypasses the ring. Rock room: left-wall keyhole/shop door opened without a key this run; shop sells bomb 5¢ and card 15¢; right-wall exit returns to rock room; bottom hatch → tutorial; top hatch → TNT room. TNT room: chests/barrels/bomb-bug; top hatch → boss room; bottom trapdoor → rock room. Boss room: left-wall statue with red glow/eyes, gilded sack/mound, embedded eye-faces in right rocks, card on floor, bottom trapdoor → TNT room; no other exit observed. Dark stone room: left-wall exit → tutorial; top-wall red-barred chests, central spiked chest, two floor holes likely pits, black spiders.

FAILED/CAUTION: attacking the left-wall statue repeatedly; attacking embedded eye-faces; assuming chests won't hurt; contact at low HP; lingering in green clouds or brazier fire; shooting into nearby walls/rocks; assuming hatches/gates open without centered repeat presses; assuming coins/pickups collect on near-touch; assuming all poop gives loot; assuming Q card works. Item banners (TECH X; MATCH STICK—Tastes like burning; 2 OF SPADES—Item multiplier) can replace/hold the active item; after Match Stick, ring bursts were not visibly firing (unconfirmed).

UNRESOLVED: how to progress past the boss/TNT/statue loop; whether the statue or embedded eye-faces are invulnerable or high-HP; what gold item near the statue is; whether red-barred/spiked dark-room chests are openable; what the floor holes do; card effects (Q unclear; 2 of Spades 'Item multiplier' unknown); meaning of all-hollow hearts; how to reach the rock-ring chest (bomb failed; placement/method uncertain); keyhole shop door opened without a key, so appearance may not strictly require one.
